Changing lives one smile at a time

2273 Chartermark Drive, Midlothian, VA 23114
(804) 739-3131

Monday-Thursday: 8:00am-5:00pm
Friday: 8:00am-2:00pm
Saturday-Sunday: Closed

Give yourself the smile you deserve. At Commonwealth Dentistry in Midlothian, we work with our patients to provide a premier dental experience. Our Midlothian dentists and dental team always put you and your needs first, ensuring a comfortable and convenient experience every time you walk through our doors.
We offer comprehensive general, cosmetic, and restorative treatments right here in office, ensuring that you’ll always be able to get the care you need from a dentist you know and trust.
Our Midlothian dentistry services include:
We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.
We’re proud to provide an experience that puts you first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.
Our Midlothian dentist office has specialized orthodontists, cosmetic dentists, and more on staff.
Experiencing a dental emergency? We’ll do our best to see you the very same day and get you back to feeling like yourself.

Dr. Tiannie Phan is a dedicated dental professional who grew up in Phoenix, AZ, and pursued her passion for dentistry at Virginia Commonwealth University. Throughout her academic career, Dr. Phan was actively involved in research, leadership, and community service. She served as a student ambassador for Give Kids a Smile, held a leadership role in the ASDA District 4 cabinet, and participated in numerous Mission of Mercy (MOM) projects.

Dr. Phan has been passionate about dentistry since childhood, inspired by positive early experiences at her pediatric dental office and her own orthodontic journey. Today, she channels that enthusiasm into esthetic dentistry, with a particular interest in anterior composites, crowns, and bridges. She is committed to making patients feel confident in their smiles and prioritizes comfort and education in every visit.

Outside of the office, Dr. Phan enjoys staying active through yoga, Pilates, and rock climbing, and finds joy in creative pursuits like hand-building pottery, gardening, and cooking. A true foodie and explorer at heart, she loves traveling and discovering new cuisines and cultures. Dr. Phan is also deeply committed to giving back and hopes to continue serving underserved populations through local free clinics and outreach initiatives.
